Model.whisper-large-v3.Description: The largest and most accurate Whisper model: about a hundred languages, the language is detected by itself. For a video card with 4 GB of memory or more; in Q5, from 2 GB.
Model.whisper-large-v3-turbo.Description: Large v3 with a lighter decoder: almost the same accuracy, several times faster. The best choice for most video cards: from 3 GB of memory; in Q8 and Q5, from 1.5 GB.
Model.whisper-medium.Description: A balance of accuracy and speed for older and weaker video cards: from 2 GB of memory; in Q8 and Q5, from 1 GB. Works on the processor too.
Model.whisper-small.Description: The lightest model that still recognizes speech well: fast on the processor and on a video card built into it, from 1 GB of memory.
Quantization.F16.Name: F16 · full precision
Quantization.F16.Description: Full precision: the most accurate, the largest file and the most memory.
Quantization.Q8.Name: Q8 · 8 bits
Quantization.Q8.Description: 8 bits: practically the accuracy of full precision at about half the size and memory.
Quantization.Q5.Name: Q5 · 5 bits
Quantization.Q5.Description: 5 bits: the smallest and fastest, a little less accurate. For video cards with little memory and for the processor.

Models.RunsOnCpuHint: Works at a usable speed without a video card.
Models.SpeechWindowHint: From the heaviest and most accurate to the lightest. Choose the quantization that fits the memory of your video card; a model is downloaded once and kept in the Data/Models folder of the application.

VoiceModel.qwen3-tts-1.7b.Description: Qwen3-TTS by Alibaba: natural speech in ten languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian) in the voice of a short sample. Give it a sample: without one it speaks noticeably worse. For a video card with 4 GB of memory or more.
VoiceModel.chatterbox-turbo.Description: Chatterbox Turbo by Resemble AI: expressive English narration, and fast. Speaks in its own voice or in the voice of a sample. From 2 GB of video memory.
VoiceModel.kokoro-82m.Description: Kokoro: a small English model with 28 American and British voices to choose from. Fast even on the processor.
VoiceModel.chatterbox-multilingual.Descr: Chatterbox Multilingual by Resemble AI: 23 languages, Russian among them. Speaks in its own voice or in the voice of a sample. From 2 GB of video memory.
LlamaCpp.Description: Runs the voice models on the video card or the processor. Every piece of text is spoken by a process of its own, so the model leaves memory as soon as it is done.
